name: Cliffspring River Sample
summary: In Darkshore, foul water gathers at the base of the Cliffspring River waterfall. Drawn for Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine, the vial shows that corruption is moving toward the coast.

sections.title: A Tainted Current
sections.body: The Cliffspring River runs from Darkshore's eastern heights, past ancient stone bridges, and into the sea at Mist's Edge. Its clear waters have turned foul and visibly corrupted. Thundris Windweaver, a night elf in Auberdine, fears the tainted flow will reach the settlement's shore and water supply. He sent travelers to draw water from the pool beneath the river's lower waterfall. The sample confirms that unnatural rot is moving downstream toward the coast.

sections.title: Echoes of Felwood
sections.body: Blackwood furbolgs live along the river upstream and suffer under its darkening influence. Thundris recognizes the water's corruption as coming from high above the cliffs to the east, in Felwood. The demonic sickness blighting the mountaintops is seeping into Darkshore's watersheds, and Auberdine's defenders must prepare to respond.

faq.q: Where is the Cliffspring River Sample collected?
aliases: where do i get the sample
faq.answer: The sample comes from the pool beneath the first Cliffspring River waterfall, north of Auberdine. Follow the river inland to the waterfall beneath an overhead bridge.

faq.q: Why does Thundris Windweaver need this water?
faq.answer: Thundris fears the foul river water will contaminate Auberdine's coastal waters. A sample lets him study the taint and plan how to counter it.

faq.q: What is causing the Cliffspring River to turn foul?
faq.answer: The true source lies east in Felwood, where lingering demonic blight is seeping into the mountain headwaters. Corrupted Blackwood furbolgs live along the river, too.

faq.q: Are the Blackwood furbolgs responsible for the poison?
faq.answer: The Blackwood furbolgs worsen the trouble along the riverbanks, but they are not its root cause. They have fallen prey to the wider corruption flowing from the blighted lands to the east.

angles.text: For the night elves of Auberdine, corruption in northern Kalimdor's waters is a grave sign of the blight spreading from Felwood.
As a druid, you know the balance of natural waterways matters. The Cliffspring sample's unnatural toxicity needs urgent study and cleansing.
